html:
Unique Research · Insight / earnings analysis · June 15, 2023 · Full rewrite — not a stub

Kunlun Tech (昆仑万维) FY2022 (filed Feb 28, 2023): revenue ¥4.73B (−2.3% YoY); attributable net profit ¥1.15B (−25.5%); gross profit ¥3.73B, GM ~78.8% (slightly up); operating net profit ¥760M (+74.0%); attributable operating NP ex-investment ¥640M (+112%). Core ops healthy despite headline declines.

01 Company & segments

Founded 2008 as web-game developer/publisher; expanded mobile/client games, then social/news via M&A. 2020 platform push: acquired Opera, Star Group — audio social, metaverse, global traffic. Five blocks: Opera (info distribution), Star Group (voice social), Xianlai Mutual Entertainment (casual), Ark Games (mobile), tech equity investment / Kunlun Capital (TMT/SaaS/healthcare; newer energy sleeve).

Opera: AI-driven news/services browsers + feed + games across Europe/Africa/E/SE Asia; Q4’22 MAU 320M; OPay growth in high-ARPU markets. StarX / StarMaker: karaoke + voice rooms; MAU once 20.73M (+11%); MusicX Lab ships AI songs to 180+ A/V platforms; Oculus App Lab / SideQuest VR push. Ark Games: MMORPG/SLG etc. across 150+ countries. Xianlai: top-2 China local mahjong/Dou Dizhu; RPG-hybrid modes; livestream chess/cards.

02 AIGC roadmap

Post-period release: Kunlun Tiangong foundation model (QA, text/code gen, translation) — Monte Carlo tree search for safe 10k-char dialogues. StarX + ArkGames merged into StarArk to focus AIGC. Dec 2022 model suite: SkyPaint / SkyMusic / SkyText / SkyCode. SkyMusic chord accuracy 92.5% vs prior SOTA 64.7%; 31 languages; partners across music/auto/games/edu/fashion/entertainment. MusicX Lab: ~20 AI songs on 180+ platforms.

Feb 2022: Alibaba Cloud compute-cluster partnership (LLM train, algo/arch co-design, pipeline, storage, TCO) to open AIGC for SMEs/devs. Constraint: ~200-card train cluster vs frontier; 2022 R&D ¥736M (15.54% of revenue) — gap vs leaders. Tiangong strong on semantics/logic; math still weak.

03 Performance

Revenue ~¥4.74B (−2.4%); attributable ~¥1.15–1.17B still industry-front. Core operating NP ex-invest ¥760M (+74%); some cuts show attributable operating NP ¥830M (+170%+). GM ~78.8% (+~7 ppt) on social ops upgrade. Mix: social entertainment 35%, ads 27%, search 20%, games 15%. Social entertainment GM >90% (+23 ppt). History: post-2017 Xianlai buy revenue ¥3.44B (+41.7%); 2020 Grindr disposal + Ark soft → ¥2.74B (−25.7%); 2021–22 Opera/StarX consolidation → ¥4.850B / ¥4.737B.

Geo: domestic ¥1.16B (22.5%); overseas ¥3.67B (77.54%). Overseas revenue +7.2% YoY; overseas GM 81.8% (+9.9 ppt); overseas social GM 87.1% (+35.2 ppt) on StarMaker monetization. Opera 2022: revenue $330M (+31.9%); attributable NP $15.035M (turnaround); adj. EBITDA $68.08M (+134.7%). Q4 MAU 324M; annualized ARPU $0.83→$1.2 (+42%) via high-ARPU geo focus.

Investment income path: 2019 ¥650M → 2020 ¥3.36B (Grindr ~98% sale; attributable NP ¥4.99B) → 2021 ¥1.67B → 2022 ¥140M — prudent exits + impairments drove headline NP down, not core ops. 2022 opex: sales ¥1.57B (+6.3%); R&D ¥690M (+15.8%); admin −17.4%; finance −90.9% (FX + debt repay).

04 Unique Research view

  • Aliyun base + higher R&D/compute are gating items for Tiangong commercialization at scale.
  • ~400M global MAU across Opera/StarX/Ark/Xianlai = rare China-origin traffic entry; product-matrix upgrades should compound.
  • Multi-modal monetization (search, ads, virtual goods, membership) + local product craft across geos.
  • Thesis: mix improvement + AI enablement → StarMaker/Opera keep lifting organic earnings if compute spend and matrix keep compounding.

9 CN charts/images; attach on ingest. Author Xiaorui · Review Ski.

— END —
